column1: # The container matrix's known deviations (#1124): one row per x86_64 cell whose verdict is WRONG or
# on a WRONG or REFUSED cell with no row (UNLISTED), a row whose verdict differs (CHANGED), a row whose
# cell now passes or traps (STALE: the fix deletes its own row), and a row naming no cell (UNKNOWN).
# A TRAP is a recorded outcome and has no row. The verdict holds a WRONG's check code and only the kind
# of a refusal (its message carries absolute paths). Measured at the head of #1604 on omen, native
# x86_64, compiler built from this tree: 378 cells, OK=330 WRONG=0 TRAP=20 REFUSED=28 (its parent:
# OK=310 TRAP=20 REFUSED=48). NO x86_64 cell is WRONG: every one of the 28 rows is a REFUSED — 19
# rows of #1244 are gone: since the x86_64 IR flip (#980) those cells build and observe OK. The 5
# `vec.range.*` and 5 `vec.for_in.*` WRONG rows of #1238 are gone, deleted by the fix that made those
# cells observe OK; the 15 sub-word Deque rows of #1254 were fixed by #1281.
